review_notes.details: service client_for does not recheck broken after acquiring the clients lock; sequential refusal test does not establish concurrent failed-start dedupe. Report count cap limits entries, not message bytes; framing header limit checked after read_line allocation. Preserve caveats for future hardening.

serializes_same_path checks total join elapsed time dominated by the first sleeping branch; this does not discriminate a removed mutex. Different-path timing bound may be load-sensitive. No tests modified or run.

find.txt promises .gitignore and 64KB behavior; find.rs uses fixed-skip walk_files and result-count truncation without a byte-cap call. Include asset for compile closure, not as certification of those claims.

replace_all skips disproportionality check; overlapping anchor spans can be skipped by splicing while reported count remains candidate count. Keep this distinct from F01/F02 protections; no fixture or reproduction added.

Off registry leaves BashTool default WorkspaceWrite mode while confinement reports off; explicit per-call escalation is still refused. OutputSink promise that slow/panicking consumers never affect complete capture exceeds direct callback behavior in drain_pipe.

Context rows are appended after matches rather than globally deduplicated/sorted; match-limit branch drops final-match context. Existing tests assert presence not complete ordering. Not needed to change for dependency integration.
